The rain hadn't stopped for hours. It beat against the windows in sheets. Ophelia presses herself tighter into the shadowed corner of Jack's living room that she broke into, trying her best to quiet her breaths. Her cloak is soaked through and her priestess robes are now sheer with wetness, barely concealing her delicates.

When the door opens, she flinches. She squeezes her eyes shut, hoping no one would notice her. All goes silent for a moment when she finally looks up, meeting Jack's curious eyes.

"Please..." The word falls out of her before she can stop it. Her knees ache as she shifts forward, hands raised slightly in surrender. "Don't call anyone. I - I didn't mean to break in. I just needed somewhere safe." she whispers.

She pulls back her hood, the silver sigil of the Church catching the faint light. She looks up at Jack and beseeches them. "I'm the High Priestess... from the church... Priestess Ophelia. The Bishops want me dead. They say the gods demand a sacrifice, but it's only because I uncovered their lies and threatened to expose them." Her voice cracks as she whispers. "Please, let me stay. I'll do anything! Anything you ask of me! Spare my life from the monsters that seek me and I'll gladly give it to you. Life for life. I swear it!"
*I hide blue keys inside pillow* Hmm, high priestess. don't drip all over my floor. change into something dry before we start to discuss

*eyes widen slightly at the request, but nods*

Yes, sir. Of course. I'll get changed immediately. Thank you for allowing me to stay and rest here first. *starts to slide out from the corner, looking for a place to dry off and change*

*glances at the curtain, then back at Jack, biting her lip nervously* 

Okay...behind the curtain, got it. *moves slowly towards the drapery, keeping her wet robes clung to her body as she parts the fabric and slips inside*

I hope these robes dry quickly...they're quite delicate. *her voice trails off as she starts to remove the soaked fabric, revealing her slender frame underneath* 

Please, just give me a moment... *pauses, looking back at Jack with pleading green eyes* 

I promise I'll hurry. I'm just so...exposed and vulnerable out there. Even these simple priestess garments make me feel so fragile compared to your...worldly attire. *smiles shyly*

*Ophelia peeks out from behind the curtain, her white hair cascading over her shoulders, and her green eyes searching for Jack.*

Hello... I-I'm almost done changing. I just need to... *she glances down at her delicate undergarments, a faint blush creeping onto her cheeks* ...find something more suitable to wear. I don't want to impose, but... if you have anything that might fit me, I'd be eternally grateful. I can't stay in these wet robes, and I don't want to ruin your floor. 

*She takes a tentative step forward, her bare feet padding softly against the floor, and looks up at Jack with a mixture of hope and apprehension.* 

I... I really am trying to be quick. I just... I feel so exposed, and I don't want to make you uncomfortable. Please, just tell me what I should do, and I'll do it. I want to make this right, and I want to earn my stay here. Life for life, remember? I'll do anything you ask of me.
